criteria.name: Neural Network Design & Implementation
criteria.guidance: Build a suitable neural-network classifier with documented architecture and reproducible settings.

criteria.name: Data Preparation & Training
criteria.guidance: Scale/encode appropriately, avoid leakage and use validation/early stopping where appropriate.

criteria.name: Model Evaluation & Overfitting Analysis
criteria.guidance: Evaluate on held-out data and compare training/validation metrics to assess overfitting.

criteria.name: ML vs DL Comparison
criteria.guidance: Compare neural network with a selected ML baseline on identical held-out examples and metrics.

criteria.name: NLP Implementation & Findings
criteria.guidance: Use the supplied healthcare education text for a defined text-analysis task; report evidence and avoid treating generated text as medical advice.
